roles.title: Chief Executive Officer & Founder
points: Founded and leads a digital agency providing digital marketing, strategic brand identity, automation, and web development solutions for emerging enterprises.
Drives technical architecture and lead-automation solutions to help regional businesses scale their digital presence.
Leads cross-functional teams in delivering end-to-end media and IT consulting services.

roles.title: Executive Director – Corporate Communications & PR
points: Directs national communications to align youth initiatives with the African Union’s Agenda 2063 goals.
Negotiated and finalized a strategic Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Versatile Academy & Wellness International (VAWI) for youth leadership masterclasses.
Designed and deployed the digital registration portal and ticketing system for the 1st Muchinga Youth Summit.

roles.title: Youth Ambassador
points: Serves as a brand and financial literacy ambassador, raising awareness among young people regarding capital markets, investor protection, and financial regulation.
Engages youth communities through peer outreach and educational campaigns on financial security and smart investment.

roles.title: Social Impact Award Finalist, Southern Africa
roles.tag: Project Lead & Visionary · Mulakupikwa Village, Chinsali
points: Named a Social Impact Award Finalist for Southern Africa for a community green-energy project in Mulakupikwa Village, Chinsali.
Pioneered a circular-economy project converting local agricultural waste into eco-briquettes to combat deforestation and provide sustainable cooking fuel.
Authored project architecture and pitch materials to mobilize stakeholder and community support.
